file.description:
The file that contains the links to be resolved.

This field is provided by DocumentationRenderer before starting to render links for a particular documentation
file.

title:
This link builder produces logical URI-style targets for links which will be processed later. Basically the kind
and path are concatenated and separated by colons so a link that started out as `@link DocumentationRenderer`,
parsed as the {@link DocumentationRenderer} with kind "TYPE" and path: "DocumentationRenderer", would return
"doc:type:DocumentationReference".

Logical URIs are not supported for images, so null is always returned for relative image references.

@see DocumentationRenderer
@see DocumentationRenderSpec
name: DocumentationUriLinkBuilder
